problems.symptom: Producer writes a field, key, status word or endpoint that the consumer never reads, so the behavior silently does nothing
problems.root_cause: No contract-conformance test between writer and reader. Serializers strip undeclared keys (Zod, SCHEMAFULL). Near-miss keys land on real sibling fields. Consumers are wired on one endpoint only. Each instance is fixed alone

problems.symptom: reached:true or 'verified' on wrong, partial or absent answers, and on landings that changed nothing. Also false reds that punish correct answers
problems.root_cause: Grading checks the form of the output. Oracles share scope, filter, tree or sub-goal with the builder. The LLM judge fills in where no verifier exists. The honest detector feeds the learner, not the verdict

problems.symptom: Landed commits do not run. The four copies (origin/dev, clone, mirror, running process) disagree, and convergence stalls without reporting a failure
problems.root_cause: Glue scripts and systemd units are image-baked. Seed-if-empty templates. Masked units starve pull-sync. Lease and marker leaks. Dirty or detached clones. A flaky pre-cutover gate. The converger was in none of its own convergence lists

problems.symptom: Substrate-authored landings loop, truncate live source, revert newer work, silence instruments or add hollow resolvers, and pass every gate
problems.root_cause: Gates reason about the diff text and never execute the code. The drafter edits live /vessels in place with no overlay. The staging base is not compared to the branch tip. Nothing models intent

problems.symptom: Operator fixes break shared state, over-correct metrics, or arrive inert
problems.root_cause: The gate was evaluated against its check but not against the resource it shares. Fixes verified by typecheck and tests, not by running against the real tree. Diagnoses drawn from single probes

problems.symptom: Posteriors do not differentiate: multiplicative saturation, the 1612:0 beta ratchet, an orphan arm holding 96.8% of beta, validator-dispatch at 0.205 against an empirical 0.952, distinct_means 1
problems.root_cause: No marginal or counterfactual attribution. Satisfier pseudo-arms are graded but steer nothing. About 2-4% of executions are graded. Uninformed mints outgrow the grading loop

problems.symptom: The ribosome extracts about nothing, composites are unbindable, and reuse is starved or concentrated on one donor
problems.root_cause: Stacked plumbing defects (WS counter, field nesting, status vocabulary, gates). Walk impulse ids leak as inputShapes. The satisfier short-circuit bypasses compositions. recommendReachingPath is only called from recovery

problems.symptom: Arbitrary goals die at step 0 or reach wrongly. Only the ReAct floor answers non-filesystem work. Walk reach measured 7.1%/24h on 09-02
problems.root_cause: Envelope parse gaps, env gates, a blacklist after one transient failure, write shapes resolved with no payload, target inference [] for report/convert goals, and file-writing goals that never terminalize

problems.symptom: The spoke depends on the hub for discovery and the trace store. Per-goal-host in-memory state is routed to the wrong owner. Labels are written to one node and read from another
problems.root_cause: PRODUCER_DISCOVERY_ENDPOINT and ACTIVITY_API_ENDPOINT are pinned to the hub. Hub-loopback addresses are advertised. Transport mirrors local-to-hub only. Masked units on the spoke

problems.symptom: Hardcoded vessel names and ports, stale pinned ingress, target-less egress landing on the obsidian sidecar, and auth schemes that differ per route
problems.root_cause: Consumers pin names or ports instead of using the llm-router or discovery pattern. Discovered values get persisted as config

problems.symptom: Retry forks child gaps that close at 4% (originals close at 30%). Recommit fractal. Variant sprawl of 15+ producers
problems.root_cause: Failure forks a new gap that carries the frozen summary instead of enriching the original. The source gap is reopened unconditionally

problems.symptom: Mechanisms built and specced but inert: resolver_schema served in one place, pool Thompson ranking stubbed, behaviorBaseline unimplemented, detectors mis-calibrated, post-land suite dead for a month
problems.root_cause: Built without a consumer or an exercise. A 'didn't run' result is treated as neutral

problems.symptom: Behavior sits behind unset env vars or static constants: the floor, VLLM arms, resource thresholds, tuning params falling back to env
problems.root_cause: Law 1 violations in the bootstrap tier leak into behavior

problems.symptom: Test fixture exec_test_1 / activity.test is durable in the production store and retried every 10s. Probe templates and labels are left in live tables

principles: A TS union no writer enforces is a comment, not a constraint (multiplicative-posterior 08-02)
A template can fail 1000+ times and keep positive credit (08-02)
When every gap fails the same way, suspect the environment; a gate on a shared resource must be evaluated against the sharing (verify-gate-pruned 08-10)
Measure pipeline stages independently against known-answer fixtures; one end-to-end bit per trial cannot diagnose a nine-stage pipeline (nine-layers 08-11)
reached:true + a landed sha is worth nothing without a diff read (0/4) (08-11)
A single dispatch cannot establish a routing property; test pure routing functions, n>=3 live (08-11)
Executing exports as a gate is inert and unsafe; the tractable form is a coverage requirement (08-11)
A property nothing exercises is not a property the system has; freshness, not presence (nothing-restarts 08-08)
A lesson channel cannot override a wrong spec: the wrong anchor arrives AS the task (07-31)
Say 'its input is poisoned', not 'learning is broken'; quote total_executions, never alpha+beta (09-01)
Grade whether the artifact answers THIS goal, not its form; control the grader positive/negative/ECHO and pre-register (08-10)
A field is only load-bearing if it survives serialization (08-06)
A right answer punished is worse than a wrong one credited; reached<correct is the tell (08-06, 08-07)
reached grades the compute, not the artifact; read the artifact back by the id the goal named (08-06)
Pending is derived from git; metadata is decoration, the revert is the operative act; the substrate has no revert path (08-23)
A detector that reports and continues is not a detector; verify a named failure condition before acting on it (08-05)
'The cleanup is in a finally' is not proof of release when something can kill the process (08-05)
Dispatch a batch then stop so pull-sync can converge (08-05)
is-active cannot distinguish crashed from deliberately off; skip unrun vessels entirely (08-08)
A guard must normalise the value it tests (08-08)
Verify a deploy by reading the executing artifact for content only the new code contains; origin/dev, clone, mirror and process are four different things (08-08)
A lesson learned in one place and not generalized leaves the same defect one function away (08-08)
A check that reports 'didn't run' as neutral decays silently; count the ran=false rate (09-28)
Look up the history of the mechanism that actually ran before declaring what was always missing (09-28)
Write the detector before believing the enumeration; one shared helper beats N edits right in N-1 places (psi 08-17)
An exemption must be keyed on its payload, not skipped (08-17)
Wiring an input is not enabling a behaviour (08-17)
Separate time_connect from time_total; list local dependencies before declaring a blocker external (08-17)
A cause that explains the symptom is not thereby the cause (08-17)
A lookup that failed must ABSTAIN, not report absence (08-08)
Reuse growth is gated on a family's first reach (08-08)
Convergence without correctness is memorizing a bad habit; warm-family reach is a property of hand-written verifiers (08-07)
A measurement that cannot tell 'could not ask' from 'could not answer' manufactures its trend (08-07)
A verifier that computes ground truth is not thereby enforcing it; check the claim; the verdict string must name the check that carried it (08-06)
When an oracle agrees by construction, enumerate every shared parameter: scope, filter, tree, sub-goal (08-05, 08-06)
